about.label: About Me
about.heading: Who am I?
about.intro: I am a programmer and student at Creative Hill College in Zlín. Currently, I focus primarily on web technologies and software development, with experience in frameworks like Nuxt.js and Vue.js. I am constantly learning new things and working on new projects. Here is my story.

t2.title: Gamer at heart
t2.desc: As a kid, I fell in love with games and always wanted to create one that matched my own imagination. Later, I started experimenting with Scratch, but I always aspired to work in a real game engine.

t3.title: My first Unity game and choosing a school
t3.desc: I started learning Unity and wanted to use my game as an admission project for Creative Hill College. I also built a website for the game. You can check it out in the projects section under 'Biathlon Game' – it's a project about a sport I truly enjoy.

t4.title: High School – IT Major
t4.desc: I enrolled at Creative Hill College in Zlín, where I was first introduced to languages like Python and JavaScript. During my freshman year, I built my portfolio and later applied those skills over the summer on the 'Scan The Result' project. I also started learning professional tools like Photoshop and Illustrator.

t5.title: Sophomore Year at Creative Hill College
t5.desc: In my second year, our task was to create a web application. This led me to the Nuxt.js framework, which I am constantly improving in. I've also started learning Java, SQL databases, and I'm further developing my JavaScript skills. Currently, I am working on a Unity game while continuing to master web tools and databases.
